days.description: Number of days of historical data to analyze (default: 365)

Get comprehensive technical analysis for a given ticker with enhanced logging and timeout handling.

This enhanced version provides:
- Step-by-step logging for debugging
- 25-second timeout to prevent hangs
- Comprehensive error handling
- Guaranteed JSON-RPC responses

days.description: Number of days of historical data to analyze (default: 365)

tools.name: technical_get_stock_chart_analysis
tools.description:
Generate a comprehensive technical analysis chart with enhanced error handling.

This enhanced version provides:
- 15-second timeout for chart generation
- Progressive chart sizing for Claude Desktop compatibility
- Detailed logging for debugging
- Graceful fallback on errors

ticker.description: The ticker symbol of the stock to analyze

tools.name: screening_get_maverick_stocks
tools.description:
Get top Maverick stocks from the screening results.

DISCLAIMER: Stock screening results are for educational and research purposes only.
This is not investment advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
Always conduct thorough research and consult financial professionals before investing.

The Maverick screening strategy identifies stocks with:
- High momentum strength
- Technical patterns (Cup & Handle, consolidation, etc.)
- Momentum characteristics
- Strong combined scores

limit.description: Maximum number of stocks to return (default: 20)

tools.name: screening_get_maverick_bear_stocks
tools.description:
Get top Maverick Bear stocks from the screening results.

DISCLAIMER: Bearish screening results are for educational purposes only.
This is not advice to sell short or make bearish trades. Short selling involves
unlimited risk potential. Always consult financial professionals before trading.

The Maverick Bear screening identifies stocks with:
- Weak momentum strength
- Bearish technical patterns
- Distribution characteristics
- High bear scores

limit.description: Maximum number of stocks to return (default: 20)

tools.name: screening_get_supply_demand_breakouts
tools.description:
Get stocks showing supply/demand breakout patterns from accumulation.

This screening identifies stocks in the demand expansion phase with:
- Price above all major moving averages (demand zone)
- Moving averages in proper alignment indicating accumulation (50 > 150 > 200)
- Strong momentum strength showing institutional interest
- Market structure indicating supply absorption and demand dominance

limit.description: Maximum number of stocks to return (default: 20)

filter_moving_averages.description: If True, only return stocks above all moving averages

tools.name: screening_get_all_screening_recommendations
tools.description:
Get comprehensive screening results from all strategies.

This tool returns the top stocks from each screening strategy:
- Maverick Bullish: High momentum growth stocks
- Maverick Bearish: Weak stocks for short opportunities
- Supply/Demand Breakouts: Stocks breaking out from accumulation phases

Returns:
    Dictionary containing all screening results organized by strategy

tools.name: screening_get_screening_by_criteria
tools.description:
Get stocks filtered by specific screening criteria.

This tool allows custom filtering across all screening results based on:
- Momentum score rating
- Volume requirements
- Price constraints
- Sector preferences

tools.name: portfolio_add_position
tools.description:
Add a stock position to your portfolio.

This tool adds a new position or increases an existing position in your portfolio.
If the ticker already exists, it will average the cost basis automatically.

purchase_date.description: Purchase date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

tools.name: portfolio_get_my_portfolio
tools.description:
Get your complete portfolio with all positions and performance metrics.

This tool retrieves your entire portfolio including:
- All stock positions with cost basis
- Current market values (if prices available)
- Profit/loss for each position
- Portfolio-wide performance metrics

include_current_prices.description: Whether to fetch live prices for P&L (default: True)

tools.name: portfolio_remove_position
tools.description:
Remove shares from a position in your portfolio.

This tool removes some or all shares of a stock from your portfolio.
If no share count is specified, the entire position is removed.

shares.description: Number of shares to remove (None = remove entire position)

tools.name: portfolio_clear_portfolio
tools.description:
Clear all positions from your portfolio.

CAUTION: This removes all positions from the specified portfolio.
This action cannot be undone.

confirm.description: Must be True to confirm deletion (safety check)

tools.name: portfolio_risk_adjusted_analysis
tools.description:
Perform risk-adjusted stock analysis with position sizing.

DISCLAIMER: This analysis is for educational purposes only and does not
constitute investment advice. All investments carry risk of loss. Always
consult with qualified financial professionals before making investment decisions.

This tool analyzes a stock with risk parameters tailored to different investment
styles. It provides:
- Position sizing recommendations based on ATR
- Stop loss suggestions
- Entry points with scaling
- Risk/reward ratio calculations
- Confidence score based on technicals

**Portfolio Integration:** If you already own this stock, the analysis includes:
- Current position details (shares, cost basis, unrealized P&L)
- Position sizing relative to existing holdings
- Recommendations for averaging up/down

The risk_level parameter (0-100) adjusts the analysis from conservative (low)
to aggressive (high).

tools.name: portfolio_compare_tickers
tools.description:
Compare multiple tickers using technical and fundamental metrics.

This tool provides side-by-side comparison of stocks including:
- Price performance
- Technical indicators (RSI, trend strength)
- Volume characteristics
- Momentum strength ratings
- Risk metrics

**Portfolio Integration:** If no tickers are provided, automatically compares
all positions in your portfolio, making it easy to see which holdings are
performing best.

tickers.description: List of ticker symbols to compare (minimum 2). If None, uses portfolio holdings.

days.description: Number of days of historical data to analyze (default: 90)

tools.name: portfolio_portfolio_correlation_analysis
tools.description:
Analyze correlation between multiple securities.

DISCLAIMER: This correlation analysis is for educational purposes only.
Past correlations do not guarantee future relationships between securities.
Always diversify appropriately and consult with financial professionals.

This tool calculates the correlation matrix for a portfolio of stocks,
helping to identify:
- Highly correlated positions (diversification issues)
- Negative correlations (natural hedges)
- Overall portfolio correlation metrics

**Portfolio Integration:** If no tickers are provided, automatically analyzes
correlation between all positions in your portfolio, helping you understand
diversification and identify concentration risk.

tickers.description: List of ticker symbols to analyze. If None, uses portfolio holdings.

days.description: Number of days for correlation calculation (default: 252 for 1 year)

tools.name: data_fetch_stock_data
tools.description:
Fetch historical stock data for a given ticker symbol.

This is the primary tool for retrieving stock price data. It uses intelligent
caching to minimize API calls and improve performance.

Updated to use separated services following Single Responsibility Principle.

ticker.description: The ticker symbol of the stock (e.g., AAPL, MSFT)

start_date.description: Start date for data in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 1 year ago)

end_date.description: End date for data in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

tools.name: data_fetch_stock_data_batch
tools.description:
Fetch historical data for multiple tickers efficiently.

This tool fetches data for multiple stocks in a single call,
which is more efficient than calling fetch_stock_data multiple times.

Updated to use separated services following Single Responsibility Principle.

tools.name: data_get_stock_info
tools.description:
Get detailed fundamental information about a stock.

This tool retrieves comprehensive stock information including:
- Company description and sector
- Market cap and valuation metrics
- Financial ratios
- Trading information

tools.name: data_get_adanos_market_sentiment
tools.description: Get optional Adanos market sentiment data for stocks.

ticker.description: Optional stock ticker. If omitted, returns market-wide sentiment.

sources.description: Optional list of Adanos sources: reddit, x, news, polymarket.

tools.name: data_get_news_sentiment
tools.description:
Get news sentiment analysis for a stock using Tiingo News API or LLM analysis.

This enhanced tool provides reliable sentiment analysis by:
- Using Tiingo's news API if available (requires paid plan)
- Analyzing sentiment with LLM (Claude/GPT)
- Falling back to research-based sentiment
- Never failing due to missing EXTERNAL_DATA_API_KEY

limit.description: Maximum number of news articles to analyze

tools.name: data_get_cached_price_data
tools.description:
Get cached price data directly from the database.

This tool retrieves data from the local cache without making external API calls.
Useful for checking what data is available locally.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, defaults to today)

tools.name: data_get_chart_links
tools.description:
Provide links to various financial charting websites.

This tool generates URLs to popular financial websites where detailed
stock charts can be viewed, including:
- TradingView (advanced charting)
- Finviz (visual screener)
- Yahoo Finance (comprehensive data)
- StockCharts (technical analysis)

ticker.description: The ticker symbol of the stock

tools.name: data_clear_cache
tools.description:
Clear cached data for a specific ticker or all tickers.

This tool helps manage the local cache by removing stored data,
forcing fresh data retrieval on the next request.

ticker.description: Specific ticker to clear (None to clear all)

tools.name: performance_get_system_performance_health
tools.description:
Get comprehensive system performance health report.

This tool provides an overall health assessment of the MaverickMCP system,
including Redis connectivity, cache performance, database query metrics,
and index usage analysis. Use this for general system health monitoring.

include_detailed_metrics.description: Include detailed metrics in the response

tools.name: performance_get_redis_health_status
tools.description:
Get Redis connection pool health and performance metrics.

This tool provides detailed information about Redis connectivity,
connection pool status, operation latency, and basic health tests.
Use this when diagnosing Redis-related performance issues.

Returns:
    Redis health status and connection metrics

tools.name: performance_get_cache_performance_status
tools.description:
Get cache performance metrics and optimization suggestions.

This tool provides cache hit/miss ratios, operation latencies,
Redis memory usage, and performance test results. Use this
to optimize caching strategies and identify cache bottlenecks.

Returns:
    Cache performance metrics and test results

tools.name: performance_get_database_performance_status
tools.description:
Get database query performance metrics and connection pool status.

This tool provides database query statistics, slow query detection,
connection pool metrics, and database health tests. Use this to
identify database performance bottlenecks and optimization opportunities.

Returns:
    Database performance metrics and query statistics

tools.name: performance_analyze_database_index_usage
tools.description:
Analyze database index usage and provide optimization recommendations.

This tool examines database index usage statistics, identifies missing
indexes, analyzes table scan patterns, and provides specific recommendations
for database performance optimization. Use this for database tuning.

Returns:
    Database index analysis and optimization recommendations

tools.name: performance_optimize_cache_configuration
tools.description:
Analyze cache usage patterns and recommend optimal configuration.

This tool analyzes current cache hit rates, memory usage, and access
patterns to recommend optimal TTL values, cache sizes, and configuration
settings for maximum performance. Use this for cache tuning.

Returns:
    Cache optimization analysis and recommended settings

tools.name: performance_clear_system_caches
tools.description:
Clear specific performance caches for maintenance or testing.

This tool allows selective clearing of different cache types:
- stock_data: Stock price and company information caches
- screening: Maverick and trending stock screening caches
- market_data: High volume and market analysis caches
- all: Clear all performance caches

Use this for cache maintenance, testing, or when stale data is suspected.

request.description: Cache clearing request with specific cache types

cache_types.description: Types of caches to clear: stock_data, screening, market_data, all

tools.name: agents_deep_research_financial

tools.name: agents_compare_multi_agent_analysis

tools.name: research_comprehensive_research

tools.name: research_analyze_market_sentiment

tools.name: run_backtest

tools.name: compare_strategies

Use this as your first tool to understand what's available.

tools.name: list_all_strategies
tools.description:
List all available backtesting strategies with their parameters.

Returns detailed information about each strategy including:
- Strategy name and description
- Required and optional parameters
- Default parameter values
- Example usage

tools.name: get_strategy_help
tools.description: Get detailed help for a specific strategy.

tools.name: get_decision_log
tools.description:
Query the agent decision audit trail.

Returns recent decision records showing query classifications,
agent routing, token usage, cost estimates, and outcomes.

session_id.description:
Optional session ID to filter by. If omitted, returns

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 20, max 100).

tools.name: get_tool_registry_status
tools.description:
Get tool registry status including rate limits and available tool categories.

Returns current rate limit usage and configuration for every tool category.
Useful for monitoring tool availability and diagnosing rate-limit issues.

Returns:
    Dictionary with rate_limits (current usage) and tool_categories (config).

tools.name: create_signal
tools.description: Create a persistent price/indicator alert signal. The condition dict must specify 'indicator' (price, rsi, volume, sma), 'operator' (lt, gt, lte, gte, spike, crosses_above, crosses_below), and 'threshold' (numeric, not needed for spike).

tools.name: update_signal
tools.description: Update an existing signal's label, condition, interval, or active status.

tools.name: list_signals
tools.description: List all configured signals, optionally filtering to active-only.

tools.name: delete_signal
tools.description: Delete a signal alert by ID.

tools.name: check_signals_now
tools.description: Manually trigger evaluation of all active signals against current market data. Returns a list of evaluation results including which signals triggered.

tools.name: get_market_regime
tools.description: Detect the current market regime (bull, bear, choppy, or transitional) using SPY price data and a composite multi-factor scoring model.

tools.name: get_regime_history
tools.description: Retrieve recorded market regime events from the database.

tools.name: backtest_signal
tools.description: Backtest a saved signal definition against historical OHLCV data. Walks the data bar-by-bar through the live signal evaluation engine so the entry/exit edges match what the signal would produce in production. Returns trade list and summary metrics (total return, win rate, Sharpe, max drawdown).

signal_id.description:
ID of the persisted signal whose condition will
be replayed.

initial_capital.description: Starting cash for the simulated portfolio.

tools.name: get_screening_changes
tools.description: Get recent screening changes (symbol entries and exits). Optionally filter by screen_name. Returns up to `limit` changes, ordered newest-first.

tools.name: get_screening_history
tools.description: Get screening run history for a specific symbol — showing each run in which the symbol appeared. Optionally filter by screen_name.

tools.name: schedule_screening
tools.description: Register scheduling intent for a named screen. Records the screen name and interval in the database for future integration with the scheduler. Actual periodic execution is wired during the integration pass.

tools.name: get_screening_pipeline_status
tools.description: Return overall status of the screening pipeline — latest run per screen, result counts, and any configured scheduled jobs.

tools.name: journal_add_trade
tools.description: Add an open trade to the journal. Record the symbol, side (long/short), entry price, and number of shares. Optionally include a rationale, strategy tags, and notes. Entry date defaults to now.

tools.name: journal_close_trade
tools.description: Close an existing open trade by entry ID. Provide the exit price; exit date defaults to now. PnL is automatically computed (long: exit-entry, short: entry-exit). Strategy performance metrics are recomputed for all tags on this trade.

tools.name: journal_list_trades
tools.description: List trades from the journal. Optionally filter by symbol, status (open/closed), or strategy tag. Returns up to `limit` trades (default 50), newest first.

tools.name: get_strategy_performance
tools.description: Return aggregated performance metrics for a strategy tag: win/loss count, total PnL, average win/loss, expectancy, and profit factor. Metrics are based on all closed trades tagged with this strategy.

tools.name: get_strategy_comparison
tools.description: Compare all strategies ranked by expectancy (highest first). Shows win/loss counts, total PnL, and key metrics for each strategy tag.

tools.name: journal_trade_review
tools.description: Return full details for a trade entry by ID, including all computed metrics. Shows entry/exit prices, PnL, tags, rationale, and notes.

tools.name: watchlist_create
tools.description: Create a new named watchlist for tracking ticker symbols. The name must be unique. An optional description can be provided.

tools.name: watchlist_add
tools.description: Add a ticker symbol to an existing watchlist. Optional notes can capture the thesis or context for watching the symbol.

tools.name: watchlist_remove
tools.description: Remove a ticker symbol from a watchlist.

tools.name: watchlist_brief
tools.description: Generate a scored intelligence brief for every symbol on a watchlist. Each entry includes: active signal count, upcoming catalyst flag (within 30 days), days on watchlist, and notes. Results are sorted by active signals descending.

tools.name: get_upcoming_catalysts
tools.description: List upcoming catalyst events (earnings, ex-dividend, FDA decisions, etc.) within a given number of days from today. Optionally filter to a specific list of ticker symbols.

tools.name: get_portfolio_risk_dashboard
tools.description: Compute a full risk dashboard for the named portfolio. Returns total value, sector concentration, parametric VaR (95 and 99 confidence), and total unrealised P&L.

tools.name: get_position_risk_check
tools.description: Pre-trade risk check: shows how adding a new position would affect portfolio risk. Returns current vs projected metrics including sector concentration and VaR.

tools.name: get_regime_adjusted_sizing
tools.description: Calculate position size adjusted for current market regime. Detects regime from SPY data, then scales risk percentage accordingly: bull = full risk, choppy/transitional = 75%, bear = 50%.

tools.name: get_risk_alerts
tools.description: Generate current risk alerts for the named portfolio. Checks for sector concentration (>30% warning, >50% critical), oversized positions (>20%), and portfolio drawdown (>10% loss).

tools.name: get_user_portfolio_summary
tools.description:
Get basic portfolio summary and stock analysis capabilities.

Returns available features and sample stock data.

tools.name: get_watchlist
tools.description:
Get sample watchlist with real-time stock data.

tools.description:

Returns detailed information about active connections, tool registration status,
and connection health metrics to help diagnose disappearing tools.
